skill.summary: Help users design repeatable signature workflows with approvals, reminders, sequencing, and status follow-up for high-volume document operations.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of signature-automation skill.
- Enables users to design repeatable e-signature workflows with approvals, reminders, sequencing, and status follow-up.
- Supports actionable outputs such as workflow steps, checklists, role tables, and routing logic for high-volume document operations.
- Tailored for use cases in HR, sales, procurement, legal, and other teams handling frequent document signatures.
- Integrates recommendations for using Nota Sign features like templates, sequential signing, and audit trails.
- Provides clear guidance on skill boundaries and recommended response formats.
